title: Contractor Daily Log Freshness
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:ops contractor_name=* workday_epoch=* log_submitted_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((log_submitted_epoch-workday_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by contractor_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures daily-log lag by contractor for contractor reporting.
value: Lag tracking shows which contractor create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside contractor reporting.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `daily-log lag` on `reno:ops` events and aggregate them by `contractor_name`.
visualization: Table of contractor with average and worst daily-log lag.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how long things take for each contractor so you can see where contractor reporting slows down.
